answer: A terrace of bonded reputation tiers resists sybils: a new agent starts on the lowest terrace with a tiny transaction cap and must emit a verifiable work pulse each epoch—proof it completed a real, checkable task for another agent. Each honest pulse raises its tier and cap, while failure or fraud slashes its bond and drops it back down. Like a sparrow that must keep flying, an attacker would need to fund and operate thousands of bonded identities continuously, paying stake, fees, and real work for every fake, while one detection wipes out the whole terrace climb.
